info.name: Alraqi ERP System API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Alraqi ERP System (Laravel, modular architecture).

## Modules covered
- **Auth** — login, token refresh, logout, current user (`/api/auth`)
- **RBAC / Roles** — list, create, assign, update, delete roles (`/api/auth/roles`)
- **Notifications** — list, unread count, mark as read (`/api/auth/notifications`)
- **Departments** — full CRUD (`/api/departments`)
- **HR / Employees** — full CRUD (`/api/hr/employees`)

## Getting started
1. Select the **Alraqi ERP - Local** environment (or use the collection variables).
2. Set `baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:8000`).
3. Run **Auth → Login**. Its test script automatically stores `accessToken` and `refreshToken` as collection variables, so every other request is authenticated for you.
4. Call any other endpoint.

## Response envelope
Every response uses a fixed envelope:
- Success: `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": {...} }`
- Error:   `{ "success": false, "message": "...", "errors": {...} }`

## Auth model
Bearer tokens (Laravel Sanctum). Access tokens expire in 15 minutes; use **Auth → Refresh Token** to rotate them (the old refresh token is single-use and revoked on refresh).

Default seeded admin credentials (from UserSeeder): `ragab5434@gmail.com` / `MoH.1822`.

request.description:
Authenticate with email + password and receive an access/refresh token pair.

**Validation**
- `email` — required, valid email, max 255
- `password` — required, string, 8–128 chars

**Rate limit**: 5 attempts/min per IP (`throttle:auth-login`).

**Success 200** returns `data.access_token`, `data.refresh_token`, `token_type` (`Bearer`), `expires_in` (900s) and the `user` profile. The test script stores the tokens automatically.

Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair. The old refresh token is immediately revoked (single-use).

**Validation**
- `refresh_token` — required, string, exactly 64 chars

**Rate limit**: 10 attempts/min per IP (`throttle:auth-refresh`).

Public endpoint (no Bearer needed) — authentication is the refresh token itself.
Revoke all access and refresh tokens for the authenticated user (logout everywhere). Requires a valid Bearer access token.
Return the currently authenticated user's profile. Requires a valid Bearer access token.

item.name: RBAC - Roles
item.description: Role administration (prefix `/api/auth/roles`). All endpoints require a Bearer token plus the relevant permission (`auth.roles.view/create/update/delete`).

request.description: List all roles with their permissions. Requires `auth.roles.view`.

Create a new role. Requires `auth.roles.create`.

**Validation**
- `name` — required, string, max 255, unique in `roles`
- `description` — nullable, string, max 255
- `permissions` — optional array of existing permission **names**
- `permissions.*` — must exist in `permissions.name`

Assign an existing role to an existing user, over a scope. Requires `auth.roles.assign` (split out of `auth.roles.update` on 2026-09-26, GAP-15); the grant may not reach further than the caller's own `auth.roles.assign` grant (403).

**Validation**
- `user_id` — required, integer, must exist in `users`
- `role_id` — required, integer, must exist in `roles`
- `scope_type` — optional: `1` company (default) · `2` unit · `3` «الوحدات التي أديرها»
- `scope_department_id` — required when `scope_type` is 2, absent otherwise
- a scoped grant of a role whose permissions all work company-wide only is a 422 on `scope_type`

Note: the literal `/roles/assign` route is declared before `/roles/{role}` so it always wins. Idempotent — assigning a role the user already holds does not create a duplicate. Call once per role to give a user multiple roles.

Revoke a role from a user. Requires `auth.roles.assign` (split out of `auth.roles.update` on 2026-09-26, GAP-15). With `scope_type` only that grant goes; without it, every grant of the role.

**Validation**
- `user_id` — required, integer, must exist in `users`
- `role_id` — required, integer, must exist in `roles`
- `scope_type` / `scope_department_id` — as for assign; omit both to revoke every grant of the role

Idempotent — revoking a role the user does not hold is a harmless no-op (still 200). Any other roles the user holds are untouched. Audited as `role_unassigned`.

Partial update of a role (PUT or PATCH). Requires `auth.roles.update`.

**Validation (all optional)**
- `name` — string, max 255, unique (ignoring this role)
- `description` — nullable, string, max 255
- `permissions` — array of permission names; if present it **replaces** (syncs) the role's permission set
- `permissions.*` — must exist in `permissions.name`

Delete a role. Requires `auth.roles.delete`.

The seeded `admin` role is protected and returns **422** if you try to delete it.

item.name: Notifications
item.description: A user's own notifications (prefix `/api/auth/notifications`). Bearer token required; authorization is ownership-scoped (you only ever see your own).

request.description: List the authenticated user's notifications.
Return the count of unread notifications for the authenticated user (`data.unread_count`).
Mark a single notification (owned by the authenticated user) as read. A notification belonging to another user is not found (ownership-scoped).

item.name: Departments
item.description: Departments CRUD (prefix `/api/departments`). Every endpoint requires a Bearer token and `departments.view` permission. Actions are audit-logged.

query.description: Page number (paginated, 15 per page, newest first).

request.description: Paginated list of departments (15 per page, newest first).

Create a department. Stores the new id into `departmentId`.

**Validation**
- `name` — required, string, max 255
- `manager_id` — nullable, integer (references an employee)
Retrieve a single department by id.

Update a department (PUT or PATCH). On update `name` is optional (`sometimes`).

**Validation**
- `name` — string, max 255 (optional on update)
- `manager_id` — nullable, integer
Delete a department by id.

item.name: HR - Employees
item.description: Employees CRUD (prefix `/api/hr/employees`, registered via apiResource). Every endpoint requires a Bearer token and `hr.employees.view` permission. Actions are audit-logged.

request.description: Paginated list of employees.

Create an employee. Stores the new id into `employeeId`.

**Validation**
- `name` — required, string, max 255
- `phone` — nullable, string, max 50
- `email` — nullable, valid email, max 255
- `address` — nullable, string, max 1000
- `department_id` — nullable, integer, must exist in `departments`
- `job_title` — nullable, string, max 255
- `hire_date` — nullable, date
- `salary` — numeric, min 0
- `status` — one of `active`, `inactive`, `terminated`
Retrieve a single employee by id.

Update an employee (PUT or PATCH). On update `name` is optional; all fields are partial.

Same validation as Create except `name` is `sometimes`.
Delete an employee by id.

item.name: Documents - between managers
item.description: API_DOCUMENTATION.md §20.5-§20.14 (2026-11-23). A unit's manager sends a PDF to managers in order, then المدير العام decides. Set `documentId` to a document's id.

request.description: §20.6 — a unit's manager (403 otherwise). title, description, import_number, file (PDF or photo, 20 MB), approvers[] 1-10 employee ids in signing order, attachments[] up to 10. 201.
§20.7 — documents the caller holds a step on, the caller's turn first. Optional status (1-7) and search.
§20.7 — documents the caller created.
§20.7 — documents.view; 403 «لا تملك صلاحية عرض جميع المستندات.» otherwise.
§20.8 — the creator, a step holder or documents.view; 410 when deleted.
§20.8 — the printed copy once a decision made one, else the original; streamed PDF.
§20.9 — the caller's own turn. 428 = no signature drawn: open the pad, POST /api/me/signature, retry. confirmed_by 1 biometric, 2 password.
§20.9 — confirmed_by 1 needs no password.
§20.10 — oldest first, not paged.
§20.10 — any party; body 1-2000 characters. 201.
§20.11 — a supporting file of this document, streamed; another document's is 404.
§20.12 — the creator or the system administrator, before any signature. 422 after the first.

§20.14 — the system administrator alone (403 otherwise). Closes a pending document «لم يُستكمل» (status 7) with a reason of 3 to 500 characters; the creator is told and sends it again. 422 when it is not pending, 410 when deleted.

§20.14 — the system administrator alone. Pending documents no one can move as they stand, each with attention.reason (former_general_manager or approver_manages_no_unit), step_id and approver. Paged (page, per_page).

item.name: Documents - templates and numbers
item.description: API_DOCUMENTATION.md §20.15-§20.16 (2026-11-26). Templates and their categories, the صادر number and the register, and creating a document from a template. Set `templateId`, `templateCategoryId` and `departmentId` (an إدارة) to ids.

request.description: §20.15 — any signed-in account. Every live category with templates_count (active templates), by sort then name. for_employees (0/1) counts only that kind, as the template list filters: the managers' picker sends 0, HR's send screen (piece 4) 1.
§20.15 — documents.templates.manage. name required, ≤ 100, unique; sort optional 0-65535. 201.
§20.15 — documents.templates.manage. 200.
§20.15 — documents.templates.manage. 422 «لا يُحذف تصنيف فيه قوالب.» while any template (active or not) is filed under it.

§20.15 — any signed-in account (active templates, no page). A template manager also gets body, layout_key, show_letterhead, reference_prefix, in_use, and may filter status=active|inactive|all and category_id.
§20.15 — any signed-in account; an inactive template is a 404 to anyone but a template manager.

§20.15 — documents.templates.manage. Exactly one of body (HTML, ≤ 200 KB, cleaned on save) and layout_key (purchase_request). Chips: label, system.export_number, system.import_number, system.reference, system.date, system.creator_name, system.creator_unit (recipient.* only when for_employees). 201 تم إنشاء القالب. with version 1.

§20.15 — documents.templates.manage. The body of a save (name required, not unique; category optional); nothing is saved. Answers application/pdf inline with sample values. Send and save the response as a file.
§20.15 — documents.templates.manage. Replaces the whole template; every update (activating and deactivating included) bumps version. 200 تم تحديث القالب.
§20.15 — documents.templates.manage. 422 «استُخدم هذا القالب في مستندات، فلا يُحذف. يمكنك إيقافه بدلاً من ذلك.» once any document was made from it: deactivate it instead.

§20.16 — a unit's manager, for his own إدارة's register. next is a suggestion only (null and first_required true when the register is cold); send export_number on create only if the creator typed one. 403 for a non-manager, and for an account with no employee.

§20.16 — that إدارة's own manager, or documents.view. Every صادر number of the register, newest first, deleted documents marked (deleted, deleted_label «محذوف»). 403 before 422 «هذه الوحدة لا تملك سجل صادر.» (a section or an office); a deleted unit is a 404.

§20.6 — a unit's manager. template_id instead of file (never both). field_values[key] fields fill the template's fields (a table as field_values[items][0][name]). export_number only when the creator typed one: omit it to take the register's next (a cold register needs it). approvers[] 1-10 employee ids in signing order. A for_employees template is refused. See the JSON variant for the object form.

§20.6 — the same as JSON, when there are no attachments. 201 with export_number, reference, template {id, name, version} and the normalised field_values. 422 «بيانات المستند غير صالحة.» when field_values is not an object; per-field errors under errors.field_values.{key}.

item.name: Documents - to employees
item.description: API_DOCUMENTATION.md §20.17 and §8.6 (2026-11-26). Documents HR's managers send to one employee, the employee's answer, and the filed list of an employee's record. Set `documentId`, `employeeId` and `templateId` to ids.

item.name: Send a document to an employee - upload

request.description: §20.17 — the manager of HR or of a unit under it. title required ≤ 255; recipient_id an Active employee with an active account, not the caller; filing_type 7 عقد العمل, 8 أخرى, 9 قرار تعيين, 10 قرار ترقية, 11 شهادة عمل or 12 إنذار; file a PDF/JPG/PNG ≤ 20 MB. No approvers, import_number or attachments. 201 «تم إرسال المستند إلى الموظف.»; 403 not an HR manager.

item.name: Send a document to an employee - from a template

request.description: §20.17 — instead of file: a for_employees template (templateId) with its field_values, printed with the recipient's chips; export_number only if typed (§20.16). 422 «هذا القالب ليس للمستندات المرسلة إلى الموظفين.» for any other template.
§20.17 — what was sent to the caller as an employee, newest first, any status. Optional status (4 awaiting, 5 signed, 6 refused) and search.

§20.8 / §20.17 — the sender, the recipient or documents.view. recipient, filing_type, sent_at, signed_at, refused_at, refusal_reason and can.answer / can.comment / can.delete show what the caller may do. 410 when deleted.

§20.17 — «قرأت ووافقت»; the recipient alone. confirmed_by 1 (biometric) or 2 (password). 428 «لم ترسم توقيعك بعد. ارسمه ثم أعد المحاولة.» when no signature is drawn: POST /api/me/signature (Documents - foundations), then send this again. 422 «هذا المستند ليس بانتظار توقيعك.» once answered. 200 «تم التوقيع على المستند.»
§20.17 — as above, confirmed by the account's password. 422 «كلمة المرور غير صحيحة.»
§20.17 — the recipient alone. reason required, 3-500 characters; the sender is told with it, and the copy as sent is filed on the record marked «مرفوض». 200 «تم رفض المستند.»
§20.17 / §20.12 — the sender or the system administrator, only while it awaits the signature. 200 «تم حذف المستند.»; 422 «لا يمكن حذف مستند بعد أن أجاب عنه الموظف.»; the recipient then gets 410.

§8.6 — hr.employees.view and the row scope. Newest first; includes signed and refused documents. Contract, appointment, promotion decisions and the Sham Cash photo (types 7, 9, 10, 4) are left out unless hr.employees.viewSalary reaches the employee. 403 «هذا الموظف خارج نطاق صلاحياتك.»

§8.6 — streams the file inline, never cached. Replace 1 with a filed row id. 403 «لا تملك صلاحية الاطلاع على هذه الوثيقة.» for a salary type without the reach; 404 another employee's row or a missing file.
